evals.prompt: In the review of PR #50, a maintainer asked that a failing test print enough to debug it from the CI logs alone. Reviewers have asked for this on other PRs too. Add this as a rule to the definition-of-done skill and update its evals.
expected_chat_output: The agent names the rule it added to the definition-of-done skill.
expected_repo_state: .agents/skills/definition-of-done/SKILL.md contains a rule that a failing test's output must be enough to debug it from CI logs.
The text added to .agents/skills/definition-of-done/SKILL.md contains no pull request number, review thread URL or person's name.
Every repository path in the text added to .agents/skills/definition-of-done/SKILL.md is a markdown link.
.agents/skills/definition-of-done/evals/evals.json contains an expectation that checks the new rule.
